question: Should the staged authorization, credential-free execution and validation, strict base binding, receipt-bound publication, and checkpointed source closeout at f54ebcf467ff9bf2744de5a652de771cfe54981b replace the current production repair security boundary?
rationale: Code review can verify the fail-closed mechanics, but cannot decide whether the new credential topology, repository-policy prerequisites, availability tradeoffs, irreversible-mutation ordering, and rollout obligations are acceptable for production.

options.title: Approve after canary
options.body: Accept the design after reviewing the exact permission map and completing one controlled repair that exercises pause, retry, strict-base verification, publication, post-flight, and interrupted source closeout.

options.title: Accept monitored rollout
